# UnitWise — Free Unit Converter

> Free unit conversion tools at convert.wezzik.com. Convert length, weight, volume, temperature, pressure, speed, time, energy, angle, frequency, fuel economy, cooking measurements and digital storage. Accurate, instant, no signup.

## Popular Converters

- [PSI to Bar](https://convert.wezzik.com/psi-to-bar.html): Convert PSI to bar and back for tire pressure and industrial gauges.
- [Bar to PSI](https://convert.wezzik.com/bar-to-psi.html): Bar to pounds per square inch conversion.
- [KPA to PSI](https://convert.wezzik.com/kpa-to-psi.html): Kilopascal to PSI conversion.
- [1 Cup in ML](https://convert.wezzik.com/cups-to-ml.html): US cup to milliliters conversion.
- [Cups to ML](https://convert.wezzik.com/cups-to-ml.html): Convert cups to milliliters for cooking.
- [ML to Cups](https://convert.wezzik.com/ml-to-cups.html): Milliliters to cups conversion.
- [Grams to Cups](https://convert.wezzik.com/grams-to-cups.html): Weight to volume for cooking ingredients.
- [Grams to Ounces](https://convert.wezzik.com/grams-to-ounces.html): Gram to ounce conversion.
- [Celsius to Fahrenheit](https://convert.wezzik.com/celsius-to-fahrenheit.html): Temperature conversion °C to °F.
- [KG to LBS](https://convert.wezzik.com/kg-to-lbs.html): Kilograms to pounds conversion.
- [KM to Miles](https://convert.wezzik.com/km-to-miles.html): Kilometers to miles conversion.
- [MPH to KMH](https://convert.wezzik.com/mph-to-kmh.html): Miles per hour to kilometers per hour.
- [OZ to ML](https://convert.wezzik.com/oz-to-ml.html): Fluid ounces to milliliters.
